timing: The day of the Rat in the sixty-day cycle, in the hour of the Rat (11 pm – 1 am)

traditionNote: The branch, element, yin and yang, double hour, month, direction, season, trines, secret friends, clashes and the Great Race are traditional Chinese lore.
